The '''Capture of the Mon Calamari ship''' was a battle that took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A [[Mon Calamari capital ship (Clone Wars)|Mon Calamari ship]] carrying [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Quarmall]] and a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|younglings]] was ambushed by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] fleet. The ship was boarded by [[Grievous]] and contingent of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], who overpowered the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] crew and Jedi Master Quarmall. Quarmall was left for dead by Grievous, but eventually managed to survive due to his [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] physiology. The [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] were captured and imprisoned by Grievous.<ref name="SW:GG" />
